what_it_does: Varun Beverages Limited manufactures, distributes, and sells a wide portfolio of carbonated soft drinks, non-carbonated beverages, packaged drinking water, and snack products under PepsiCo brands to consumers across multiple countries, generating revenue through product sales.
other_facts: Consolidated volumes grew by 7.9% in CY 2025.
Profit after tax increased by 16.2% to 30,620.4 Million in CY 2025.
There are 38 manufacturing plants in total in India.
